# KIXORA — Luxury Footwear & Street Couture
> Step Into More. Premium sneakers, athletic performance footwear, and designer collections.

## Website Details
- Brand: KIXORA
- Category: Luxury Footwear, Sneakers, Athletic Shoes, Boots
- Official Site: https://kixora.vercel.app

## Endpoints & Pages
- / : Home page with featured drops, trending footwear, and brand philosophy
- /products : Footwear catalog with multi-filter (Sneakers, Running, Boots, Casual, Limited Drops, EU Sizes 38-45)
- /orders : User order history and shipment tracking
- /user : Profile management and luxury member credentials
- /help : Customer assistance, FAQ, returns, and global shipping policies
